title: Services
hint: The programs that make up the box. Start or stop them here, and choose which ones start at boot.
entryHint: Check the programs that make up the box, start or stop them.
loadFailed: The list of services could not be read.
confirmHint: It stops for a few seconds and starts again. Whatever relies on it waits meanwhile.

restartWarning.calaos-server: This page loses its connection for about 30 seconds. It reconnects by itself.
restartWarning.haproxy: This page loses its connection for a few seconds. It reconnects by itself.
restartWarning.calaos-container: This page loses its connection for a few seconds. Admin features are unavailable for about 10 s.

stopHint: It starts again at the next reboot or update. To keep it off, turn off Start at boot.
disableTitle: Stop {name} now and at every boot?

consequence.mosquitto: Zigbee, Hue, Enphase and MQTT devices stop responding.
consequence.influxdb: History is no longer recorded, and Grafana shows nothing new.
consequence.grafana: Graphs are no longer available. History keeps being recorded.

startNote: It will not start again after a reboot or an update. Turn on Start at boot to keep it.
selfRestarting: {name} is restarting. This page reconnects by itself, then checks that it came back.
upgrading: An update is running: every control waits until it ends.

done.enable: Started, and it now starts at boot.
done.disable: Stopped, and it no longer starts at boot.

failed.restart: It did not start again. Its logs tell why.
failed.start: It did not start. Its logs tell why.
failed.stop: It did not stop cleanly. Its logs tell why.
failed.enable: It did not start. Its logs tell why.
failed.disable: It did not stop cleanly. Its logs tell why.

result.not_found: This service is not installed on the box.
result.timeout: No confirmation after {seconds} seconds. Check its state above.
result.upgrade_in_progress: An update is running. Try again once it has ended.
